events.evidence: Sharp 470 Hz tick as the tilted saucepan lowers and settles into the basin.
Hollow knock with a 320 Hz decay as the saucepan rocks toward the basin's left wall and eases back.
Abrupt resonant knock coincides with a small rock of the saucepan against the basin.
Sharp broadband attack and short decay as the saucepan rocks against the basin's left side.
Isolated resonant knock as the tilted saucepan rocks low against the basin's left interior.
Two sharp, hollow knocks align with the pot rocking low in the basin, then stopping at its upper-left wall.
A short resonant knock aligns with the pot turning face-up and settling against the basin.
Sharp hollow knock as the saucepan rocks down and settles into the basin.
Brief raspy swish as the sponge clears the pot lip and slides across the basin floor.
